articles.title: ₹2 Crore Grudge Turns Violent”: Man Rams Car into Dealer in Mangaluru Murder Bid
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Mangaluru East Police have arrested a 26-year-old man for allegedly attempting to murder a person over a financial dispute linked to a land deal. The accused, identified as Mohammed Shareef, was booked under relevant sections of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023, police said.

body.html:
Mangaluru East Police have arrested a 26-year-old man for allegedly attempting to murder a person over a financial dispute linked to a land deal.

The accused, identified as Mohammed Shareef, was booked under relevant sections of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023, police said.

Land Dispute Behind Attack

According to Police Commissioner Sudheer Kumar Reddy, the complainant, Mohan Das Shetty (56), a resident of Mallikatte, had prior land dealings with Shareef and his father Mohammed Iqbal.

Police said Shareef had invested around ₹2 crore in properties at Kana, Surathkal and Vamanjoor, and allegedly suspected cheating in the transactions, leading to a grudge against Shetty.

Deliberate Crash Attempt

On Tuesday around 11:00 am, Shareef allegedly confronted Shetty on Arya Samaj Road and snatched his mobile phone during an argument.

Later, while Shetty was riding his two-wheeler, the accused reportedly rammed his car into the vehicle from behind at high speed in an alleged attempt to kill him.

Arrest and Probe

Following the complaint, police registered a case and arrested the accused. He will be produced before the court. Further investigation is underway.

#Mangaluru #CrimeNews #AttemptToMurder #BreakingNews #LandDispute #Karnataka #PoliceAction #IndiaNews

articles.title: “Arrest Post Hijacked”: Vulgar Trolls Target Woman SP on Mirzapur Police Instagram
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A recent Instagram post by Mirzapur Police showcasing a successful arrest has sparked widespread outrage after its comment section was flooded with vulgar and body-shaming remarks directed at Superintendent of Police Aparna Rajat Kaushik.

body.html:
A recent Instagram post by Mirzapur Police showcasing a successful arrest has sparked widespread outrage after its comment section was flooded with vulgar and body-shaming remarks directed at Superintendent of Police Aparna Rajat Kaushik.

The post, shared four days ago, detailed the arrest of a ₹25,000 reward-listed accused, identified as a habitual cattle smuggler. According to police, a joint team of Jigna police and SOG surveillance units apprehended the accused and recovered a motorcycle along with ₹40,000 in cash. The update also featured a video statement by SP Kaushik.

Abuse Overshadows Police Work

However, instead of acknowledging the operation, several users posted offensive and inappropriate comments targeting the woman officer’s appearance. The comment section reportedly included explicit language, sexist slurs, and body-shaming remarks.

Public Outrage

Screenshots of the abusive comments have since gone viral, drawing sharp criticism from social media users. Many have condemned the trolling and demanded stricter action against those responsible.

Calls for Accountability

Users have urged authorities to treat such online harassment as a serious offence and ensure accountability. The incident has once again highlighted concerns over rising misogyny and lack of digital civility, even on official law enforcement platforms.

#Mirzapur #WomenInUniform #OnlineHarassment #CyberAbuse #RespectWomen

articles.title: “Human Parcel Stunt”: Bengaluru Family Packs Elderly Man in Sack for Reel, Sparks Outrage
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: In a bizarre incident in Bengaluru, a family allegedly packed an elderly man inside a sack and attempted to “courier” him as part of a social media stunt, police said.

body.html:
In a bizarre incident in Bengaluru, a family allegedly packed an elderly man inside a sack and attempted to “courier” him as part of a social media stunt, police said.

The incident took place under the Vyalikaval police station limits, where five family members—including a woman, her husband, mother-in-law and brother-in-law—arrived at a courier office carrying a large package on Tuesday.

Shocking Discovery

Courier staff grew suspicious when the family refused to disclose the contents of the package. Upon opening it, they were shocked to find the woman’s father inside the sack. Sources said the elderly man appeared distressed and was struggling to breathe.

Stunt for Social Media

The family later claimed the act was intended to film a reel highlighting travel difficulties during the festive season of Ugadi and Ramzan, suggesting that “couriering a person” was the only option due to unavailability of bus tickets.

Despite being confronted, the family reportedly argued with staff and insisted that the parcel be accepted.

Police Action

Police were alerted and took the family into custody for questioning. They were later let off with a stern warning after recording an apology video, admitting their actions were irresponsible.

Officials cautioned against such dangerous stunts for social media attention.

#Bengaluru #ViralStunt #SocialMediaMadness #Ugadi

articles.title: “Gas Crisis Theft”: Thieves Steal 4 LPG Cylinders from Ex-Judge’s House in Bhopal
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Amid the ongoing LPG shortage, a shocking theft has been reported from the residence of a former judge in Madhya Pradesh’s Bhopal. The incident took place on the night of March 15 in Om Shiv Nagar, under the Lalghati area. CCTV footage of the चोरी surfaced on Tuesday.

body.html:
Amid the ongoing LPG shortage, a shocking theft has been reported from the residence of a former judge in Madhya Pradesh’s Bhopal.

The incident took place on the night of March 15 in Om Shiv Nagar, under the Lalghati area. CCTV footage of the चोरी surfaced on Tuesday.

According to Kohefiza police, the complaint was filed by advocate Robin Jain, son of late Vimal Kumar Jain, a former judge.

CCTV Reveals Modus Operandi

The footage shows three youths arriving on a motorcycle late at night. One of them got down, surveyed the area, and signalled the others. Shortly after, two youths returned, and one entered the parking area.

He then removed all four LPG cylinders one by one, loaded them onto the motorcycle, and fled the spot.

Theft Confirmed Next Morning

As per the complaint, four empty cylinders were kept in the parking area around 12:30 am. The theft came to light at around 9 am when they were found missing.

The cylinders included one from Bharat Gas and three from Indane, with an estimated value of around ₹6,000.

Probe Underway

Police said efforts are ongoing to identify the accused through CCTV footage, and arrests are expected soon.

#Bhopal #LPGShortage #Theft #CCTV #CrimeNews

articles.title: “Likes Over Life?”: Pregnant YouTuber Vaishnavi Murdered by Husband Over Viral Videos Row
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: In a shocking incident in Telangana’s Jagtial district, a woman YouTuber, Vaishnavi, was allegedly murdered by her husband Haribabu in Korutla Mandal, police said.

body.html:
In a shocking incident in Telangana’s Jagtial district, a woman YouTuber, Vaishnavi, was allegedly murdered by her husband Haribabu in Korutla Mandal, police said.

The incident took place in Madapur village, where the accused reportedly stabbed Vaishnavi to death following a domestic dispute. She was pregnant at the time of the attack, adding to the gravity of the crime.

Dispute Over Social Media Content:
According to police investigation, the couple had been creating videos portraying Haribabu in an alleged extramarital affair. Investigators are probing whether these videos were made purely to gain views or had another motive.

Reports indicate that Haribabu had repeatedly objected to such content, claiming it was damaging his reputation. Police suspect that frequent arguments over these videos escalated tensions between the couple.

Love Marriage Turns Tragic:
Vaishnavi, a native of Madapur, had met Haribabu through YouTube. Their relationship turned into a love marriage about two years ago, despite opposition from Haribabu’s family. The couple had been living at Vaishnavi’s parental home since then.

Fatal Attack:
On the night of the incident, a quarrel reportedly broke out between the two. During the altercation, Haribabu allegedly attacked Vaishnavi with a knife, killing her on the spot, before fleeing the scene.

Investigation Underway:
Police have registered a case and launched a manhunt to apprehend the accused. Family members of the victim have demanded strict punishment, alleging that Vaishnavi was killed unjustly.

Authorities are continuing their investigation to determine the exact sequence of events and the role of ongoing disputes in the crime.

#Jagtial #Telangana #BreakingNews #JusticeForVaishnavi #IndiaNews

articles.title: Speeding Truck Crushes Mother, Daughter to Death in Mirzapur
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A tragic road accident on the Varanasi–Rewa Highway in Uttar Pradesh’s Mirzapur district claimed the lives of a woman and her minor daughter on Saturday afternoon.

body.html:
A tragic road accident on the Varanasi–Rewa Highway in Uttar Pradesh’s Mirzapur district claimed the lives of a woman and her minor daughter on Saturday afternoon.

The incident occurred on the Bastra flyover under Lalganj police station limits, where a speeding truck rammed into a motorcycle carrying a family from Ghazipur.

The deceased have been identified as Rita (35) and her 12-year-old daughter Soumya, who died on the spot. Rita’s husband, Manoj Chaudhary (38), who was riding the motorcycle, sustained serious injuries. The truck driver, Rohit Tiwari (35), was also injured. Both have been referred to a trauma centre for advanced treatment.

According to police, the family, residents of Hariballavpur Tiwari Pur village in Mohammadabad area of Ghazipur, were travelling to Mauganj in Madhya Pradesh, where Manoj intended to take up parwal cultivation.

CCTV footage shows the truck losing control on the flyover. In an apparent attempt to avoid other vehicles, it hit the motorcycle, crashed into the bridge railing, crossed lanes, and struck the opposite barrier.

Police reached the spot promptly and shifted the injured to Lalganj Community Health Centre before referring them to Mirzapur Trauma Centre. The accident led to panic and temporary traffic congestion on the flyover before normal movement was restored.

Station House Officer Abhay Kumar Singh said the bodies have been sent for post-mortem, and further investigation is underway.

#Mirzapur #RoadAccident #UttarPradesh #BreakingNews #TruckAccident #HighwayTragedy #IndiaNews #RoadSafety

articles.title: “Panchayat Killer Shot Dead”: Bareilly Double Murder Accused Gunned Down in Police Encounter
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: In a dramatic police encounter in Bareilly, Afsar alias ‘Baura’ (40), accused of brutally murdering his mother-in-law and brother-in-law, was shot dead on Tuesday morning.

body.html:
In a dramatic police encounter in Bareilly, Afsar alias ‘Baura’ (40), accused of brutally murdering his mother-in-law and brother-in-law, was shot dead on Tuesday morning.

According to SSP Anurag Arya, the accused was cornered around 6:00 AM within the limits of Izzatnagar police station following a tip-off. When asked to surrender, Afsar allegedly opened fire at the police team. In retaliatory firing, he sustained two bullet injuries to the chest and later died while being taken to the district hospital. Two constables were also injured in the exchange of fire.

Brutal Panchayat Murders

Police said the incident comes just 17 hours after Afsar carried out a gruesome attack during a panchayat meeting on Monday afternoon. The meeting was convened to resolve a domestic dispute between Afsar and his wife, Saima.

During the gathering, held at a relative’s house, Afsar suddenly turned violent and repeatedly stabbed his mother-in-law Asma (54) and brother-in-law Adil (20), killing both on the spot. He also attacked his wife when she tried to intervene, leaving her critically injured. She is currently undergoing treatment at a private hospital.

Background and Manhunt

Afsar, an ambulance driver and resident of Rahpura in Bareilly, had been married for nine years and has two children. His wife had been staying at her parental home for the past few days due to ongoing domestic disputes.

Following the killings, police launched a massive manhunt, forming five teams to trace the accused. On Tuesday morning, he was tracked down near Sahara Ground in Mudiya Ahmadnagar, where he was reportedly armed and suspected to be planning another attack.

Criminal History

Police revealed that Afsar had a history of serious crimes. He was convicted in 2009 for murdering his maternal uncle and was sentenced to life imprisonment. He secured bail from the High Court in 2015 and had been out of jail since. A case of domestic violence was also filed against him by his wife in 2022.

Authorities recovered a pistol, ammunition, and a knife from his possession after the encounter. Further investigation is underway.

#Bareilly #UPPolice #Encounter #BreakingNews

articles.title: ₹25 Lakh”: Inspector’s Alleged Exploitation Racket Shocks Karnataka Police
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Moodbidri Police Station Inspector Sandesh B.G. has been accused of sexual harassment and serious misconduct, with allegations that he also targeted the victim’s minor daughter. According to sources, three women in Bengaluru have submitted a complaint seeking a high-level probe.

body.html:
Moodbidri Police Station Inspector Sandesh B.G. has been accused of sexual harassment and serious misconduct, with allegations that he also targeted the victim’s minor daughter.

According to sources, three women in Bengaluru have submitted a complaint seeking a high-level probe. The complaint has been forwarded to the Chief Minister, Home Minister, Director General of Police (DGP), Chief Secretary, and the State Women’s Commission.

The victim has alleged sexual assault by Inspector Sandesh B.G., posted under the Mangaluru Commissionerate. She has released an audio clip supporting her claims, triggering widespread outrage and bringing disrepute to the police department.

As per the complaint, around two years ago, the victim’s husband was arrested in a case. The inspector allegedly pressured her for sexual favours in exchange for his release. He also demanded ₹25 lakh and threatened to open a “rowdy sheet” against her husband.

Taking serious note of the allegations, Mangaluru Police Commissioner Sudhir Kumar Reddy has placed Inspector Sandesh under suspension.

The complaint accuses the officer of targeting women who approached the police station for family disputes or official work, and allegedly blackmailing them. It is further alleged that he falsely implicated the victim’s husband and demanded either sexual compliance or money for his release. He also allegedly claimed he had paid ₹50 lakh to secure his posting.

The complainant stated that the inspector would allegedly scale the compound wall at night, enter her house, drag her, and force her to dance. Similar behaviour has also been alleged during his previous posting at Belthangady Police Station.

The complaint adds that several women visiting the station for passport verification and other official work were also harassed, but many hesitated to come forward.

In a shocking claim, the victim alleged that the inspector also targeted her minor daughter and threatened to approach her at her college. An audio clip related to this allegation has gone viral, intensifying public outrage.

The complainant stated that despite filing an earlier complaint with the Mangaluru City Police Commissioner, no action was taken. She has now demanded that the case be handed over to a Special Investigation Team (SIT) or the CID, citing concerns over a fair probe.

Following the viral audio, the police department has initiated a departmental inquiry. DCP Mithun stated that the investigation is being led by the ACP of the North Division, and further action will be taken based on the report.

Meanwhile, the State Women’s Commission has sought a detailed report from the Mangaluru Police Commissioner, stating that the allegations are serious, especially given the officer’s responsibility to protect women.

#Karnataka #PoliceScandal #SexualHarassment #Corruption

articles.title: Varanasi: 14 Arrested After Iftar Party on Boat in Ganga Sparks Outrage
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Police in Varanasi have arrested 14 people after a video showing an iftar gathering on a boat in the Ganga River went viral and triggered controversy. The case was registered at Kotwali Police Station following a complaint by Rajat Jaiswal.

body.html:
Police in Varanasi have arrested 14 people after a video showing an iftar gathering on a boat in the Ganga River went viral and triggered controversy.

The case was registered at Kotwali Police Station following a complaint by Rajat Jaiswal. Police confirmed that all identified accused have been taken into custody, while legal proceedings are underway.

According to officials, the group had gathered mid-river to break their fast during an iftar. The issue escalated after a video surfaced on social media allegedly showing participants consuming food, including biryani, and throwing leftover waste into the river.

The complaint alleged that disposing of food waste in the Ganga hurt religious sentiments and disrespected the sanctity of the river, prompting swift police action.

Authorities said a case has been registered against 14 named individuals along with some unidentified persons. All accused are currently being questioned as part of the investigation.

Police officials stated that statements are being recorded and evidence, including the viral video, is being examined. They added that strict action will be taken if the accusations are proven.

#Varanasi #Ganga #IftarControversy #BreakingNews #UttarPradesh

articles.title: Ghaziabad: Punjab & Sind Bank Manager Shot Dead by Guard After Leave Dispute, CCTV Surfaces
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A shocking incident was reported from Ghaziabad, where a bank manager was allegedly shot dead by a security guard following a dispute over leave. The victim, Abhishek Sharma (34), worked as a manager at Punjab & Sind Bank and was originally from Patna, Bihar.

body.html:
A shocking incident was reported from Ghaziabad, where a bank manager was allegedly shot dead by a security guard following a dispute over leave.

The victim, Abhishek Sharma (34), worked as a manager at Punjab & Sind Bank and was originally from Patna, Bihar. The incident took place on Monday afternoon in the Balram Nagar area under Loni Border Police Station.

According to police, the accused guard Ravindra Hooda, a resident of Baghpat, had been seeking leave from the manager for several days. Around 1:45 pm, he reportedly confronted Sharma inside the bank and an argument broke out over the issue.

During the altercation, the guard allegedly opened fire and shot the manager in the chest. Sharma collapsed on the spot as panic spread among customers and staff inside the bank.

The accused then fled the scene with an accomplice. Bank employees rushed the injured manager on a bike to Guru Tegh Bahadur Hospital, but he succumbed to his injuries on the way.

CCTV footage from the bank’s entrance has surfaced, showing the guard leaving the premises with another person shortly after the shooting, while others were later seen carrying the injured manager out.

Police official Gyan Prakash Rai said the accused had recently joined duty and had an ongoing dispute with the manager over leave. Police teams have been deployed to trace and arrest him.

Abhishek Sharma had been living in Ghaziabad with his wife since August 2025 after moving from Patna. Authorities have informed his family and further investigation into the case is underway.

#Ghaziabad #BankManagerMurder #UttarPradesh #PunjabAndSindBank
